name: Toastmasters International
what_it_is: Global club network with the Pathways curriculum: prepared speeches, evaluations, and Table Topics (impromptu speaking drills).
notes: Table Topics is the canonical impromptu/quick-wit exercise format; Pathways project descriptions are documented online.

name: The Moth
what_it_is: Storytelling organization running StorySLAM open-mic competitions worldwide plus paid workshops and corporate training (Moth Works).
notes: Slam format itself is a practice structure; 'How to tell a story' book + workshop curriculum.

name: Stanford GSB / Matt Abrahams — Think Fast Talk Smart
what_it_is: Podcast + 'Think Faster, Talk Smarter' book on spontaneous speaking with a 6-step method and printable practice exercises.
notes: Canonical academic treatment of impromptu speaking; book exercises extractable; free resources page.

name: Improv Encyclopedia / Improwiki
what_it_is: Free wiki-style databases of hundreds of improv games, warm-ups and exercises with instructions.
notes: Largest open exercise corpus in improv — prime extraction target for step 3.

name: Speak Up Storytelling podcast (Matthew & Elysha Dicks)
what_it_is: Podcast that workshops listener stories and teaches Homework for Life; explicit practice component each episode.
notes: Episodes model story-crafting feedback loops; pairs with Storyworthy.

name: Radical Agreement Project
what_it_is: Free daily online improv workshops (weekdays 4pm ET) focused on beginner exercises.
notes: Free daily beginner exercises — good observation target for exercise inventory.
